steps.note: Open the eRFX creation flow.
Enable the tenant behavior required for vendors to see best prices.
Give the event a searchable title required for publishing.
Create an RFQ pricing stage rather than the default auction stage.
Configure the RFQ stage before selecting its template and line items.
Apply the RFQ pricing template.
Create two line items so the pricing view contains multiple lines.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet.
Commit a valid bidding schedule.
Invite two vendors so their bids can be compared.
Publish the event so vendors can participate.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Enter the lowest bid on behalf of the first vendor, establishing the expected best price.
Confirm the surrogate bid was accepted.
Confirm the participating vendor's bid was accepted.
Open the buyer's comparison grid to inspect the best-price result.
Verify the buyer's first vendor column contains the known lowest bid of 90.
Move to the participating vendor's supplier-portal session.
Open the event's RFQ pricing view as the participating vendor.
Verify the vendor view exposes the exact lowest bid value established in the buyer's QCS.
